n, K, mod = map(int, input().split())

def fastExponentiation(base, exp):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def binomial(i, j):
    return (factArr[i] * invFactArr[j] % mod) * invFactArr[i - j] % mod

# Read input
# n, K, mod are already read above

if n & 1:
    print(fastExponentiation(K, n))
    exit()

factArr = [1] * (n + 1)
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    factArr[i] = (factArr[i - 1] * i) % mod

invFactArr = [1] * (n + 1)
invFactArr[n] = fastExponentiation(factArr[n], mod - 2)
for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
    invFactArr[i] = (invFactArr[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % mod

countBitsArr = [0] * (n + 1)
maxPowerArr = [0] * (n + 1)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(19):
        if (1 << j) & i:
            countBitsArr[i] += 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in reversed(range(19)):
        if (1 << j) & i:
            maxPowerArr[i] = 1 << j
            break

tableDP = [[0] * 20 for _ in range(n + 1)]
tableDP[0][0] = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    if (n & i) != i:
        continue
    remaining = i ^ maxPowerArr[i]
    mask = remaining
    while True:
        current = mask + maxPowerArr[i]
        c2 = i ^ current
        limit = min(K - 1, countBitsArr[c2])
        tmpVal = binomial(i, current)
        for j in range(limit + 1):
            tableDP[i][j + 1] = (tableDP[i][j + 1] + tableDP[c2][j] * tmpVal) % mod
        if mask == 0:
            break
        mask = (mask - 1) & remaining

totalResult = 0
for j in range(1, min(countBitsArr[n], K) + 1):
    totalResult = (totalResult + tableDP[n][j] * binomial(K, j) % mod * factArr[j]) % mod

totalResult = (fastExponentiation(K, n) - totalResult + mod) % mod
print(totalResult)
